svg.title: A well-shaded ball and three common mistakes, light from the top left. Good: highlight top left, a soft change to a dark teal shadow bottom right, reflected light and a cast shadow. Avoid: black used for the shadow, so the ball looks gray and dirty. Avoid: highlights on two sides, so the light seems to come from everywhere and the ball looks flat. Avoid: light and dark halves with no midtone between them, so it looks like a split ball, not a round one.
